title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 009
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute search variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Magnifying glass with a large round lens and short angled handle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs the most direct and generic magnifying glass search symbol.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the spark or gauge variants when the lens interior should stay empty.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the plainest magnifying glass with an empty lens and no added symbols.

items.depicts_observation: Smaller magnifying glass with a tighter round lens and short handle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tighter more compact magnifying glass outline.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the larger plain search icon when the smaller lens proportion is intentional.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the same basic search shape but with a noticeably smaller and tighter lens.

items.depicts_observation: Magnifying glass with a centered spark star inside the lens
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a search icon that carries an explicit spark style cue inside the lens.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain compact search when the inner spark is part of the visible signal.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot matches search_2 but adds a centered spark star inside the circular lens.

items.depicts_observation: Magnifying glass with a curved gauge mark inside the lens
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a search lens that looks partially measured or dial marked.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for spark based search icons when the inner cue is a curved gauge stroke instead.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a single curved inner mark rather than a star or empty lens.

items.depicts_observation: Magnifying glass with a large inner spark and a small outer spark
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a search icon with both an inner sparkle and an outer accent sparkle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single spark search when the extra outer spark should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one spark inside the lens and a second smaller spark floating outside.
